title: Break it on purpose
fullTitle: Break It on Purpose: Prove the Test Can Fail

scenes.narration: A test goes green. Is the bug fixed? Only if that same test could have gone red.
captions: A test goes green. Is the bug fixed?
Only if that same test could have gone red.

scenes.narration: One tap on Pay, two orders. The first request committed, the response was lost, and the retry counted as new. A fix test that never failed proves nothing.
captions: One tap on Pay, two orders.
The response was lost, and the retry counted as new.
A fix test that never failed proves nothing.

scenes.narration: So every episode runs four moves. Flaw: reproduce it on a local fixture. Control: prove the test can fail. Repair: the smallest change. Retest: the same schedule, with real numbers.
captions: Flaw: reproduce it on a local fixture.
Control: prove the test can fail.
Repair: the smallest change. Retest: the same schedule.

scenes.narration: Episode fifteen. The control reports two attempts, two orders. After the repair: two attempts, one order, and thirteen of thirteen tests pass.
captions: Episode 15: the control reports 2 attempts, 2 orders.
After the repair: 2 attempts, 1 order. 13 of 13 tests pass.

scenes.narration: Episode one. Alice asks for Bob's project. Two hundred before the repair. Four oh four after.
captions: Episode 1: Alice asks for Bob's project.

scenes.narration: Duplicates, access, stale data. Local fixtures you run with Node's built-in test runner. Each one says what it does not prove.
captions: Local fixtures, Node's built-in test runner.
Each one says what it does not prove.
